title: TrustworthyTransfers
tagline: Peer to peer transfers with wise. Verified by Flare data connector.
description: We use the Wise api to prove that a payment was sent to the correct wise account. When the payment has been verified, the user can withdraw erc20 tokens from a contract on Flare. Only the buyer is required to interact to complete the trade. The frontend is made with react and typescript
how_its_made: Because of the way the wise api works, each user needs to generate an api key to get access to the data about the transaction. The project only uses a smart contract on flare and a simple frontend that anyone can run.            There are some links to Blockscout in the frontend.
